assessment.attacker: remote sender who already possesses the independent Mattermost WebhookSecret required by the first constant-time gate
assessment.victim: a Mattermost instance with the Zoom plugin configured
assessment.securityBoundary: the Zoom webhook HMAC check behind a separate mandatory Mattermost webhook secret
assessment.observableOutcome: the production-function benchmark rejected invalid signatures and found no statistically distinguishable early-versus-late mismatch timing signal
assessment.rationale: the ordinary string comparison exists, but the recorded real-function benchmark did not confirm an exploitable oracle and reaching it already requires a separate secret; no Medium-or-higher cross-victim effect is proven
